notes: Forty-six backdrops in five families - solids, pastels, vivid gradients, radial glows, and aurora washes - plus fully transparent, with your signature in any font, ink, and position. Smaller, glassier confirmations you can move or turn off. And an important fix: licences now survive updates and reinstalls - if MacStash ever asked for your key again after updating, this puts it right for good.
